purpose: Optional sourced statistics joined to canonical ADM1 IDs independently from boundary geometry.
rules: Geometry and statistics keep separate provenance owners.
Missing statistics remain missing; no value is inferred from geometry or neighboring regions.
Each metric declares source, reference period and unit.
Population zero is not used as a missing-data sentinel.
Area supplied by a statistics source must not be described as measured from simplified display geometry unless that source explicitly says so.
